TC-04/S22.title: Time from Link tap to text on the chart, and the pad load with 25 boxes
TC-04/S22.detail: Our own addition, record-only (no UAT or ticket target, Q11). PW, local stack (numbers do not stand for dev): Patel in room 415 and 25 boxes 'QA box 01…25' seeded with quickDictation:create; three runs, each opening the pad, typing 'Bed 415, stable. run N' into a box, tapping the suggested '415 · QA Hosp Patel' Link, then opening Patel's Encounter tab (the tap->chart time includes closing the pad and opening the chart). run 1: pad 130 ms, tap->placed 118 ms, tap->server 178 ms, tap->text on Patel's Encounter tab 337 ms; run 2: pad 158 ms, tap->placed 140 ms, tap->server 234 ms, tap->text on Patel's Encounter tab 443 ms; run 3: pad 157 ms, tap->placed 128 ms, tap->server 197 ms, tap->text on Patel's Encounter tab 362 ms. Each run's text reached Patel's chart exactly once; no model action was called.
